title: Patient Flow Analytics Program Manager
description:
Responsibilities/Job Description:

The Program Manager for Flow Analytics (PMFA) is accountable for the strategic direction, governance, and ongoing evolution of enterprise analytics supporting patient flow and throughput across the health system. This role ensures that system\\-level analytics enable executive, clinical, and operational leaders to understand performance, make informed decisions, and drive improvements in patient access, capacity, and throughput. The PMFA owns the analytic vision for patient flow across the system and provides oversight for system\\-facing reporting assets and datasets, primarily—but not exclusively—delivered through Power BI. Analytics may also be delivered through Epic or other platforms when those tools best meet clinical, operational, or workflow needs. While the role maintains accountability for these assets, it does not function as the primary report developer. Instead, the PMFA guides analytic design, defines requirements, validates logic, and ensures high\\-quality delivery through collaboration with analytics teams and technical partners. Working closely with executive leadership, strategic partners, and internal subject matter experts, the PMFA translates operational and clinical questions into clearly defined, governed metrics aligned with organizational priorities. This is a high\\-visibility, individual contributor role with direct accountability to executive leadership. The PMFA serves as a trusted analytics advisor, engaging in front\\-facing, consultative work to shape performance questions, ensure analytic accuracy and trust through validation against Epic and other source systems, interpret results, and deliver outputs that are consistent, actionable, and aligned around a shared understanding of flow performance.  

  

**Responsibilities*** Leads discussions with care teams and leadership to design analytic reports using electronic medical record data, claims, and other data sources.
* Acts as an expert in defining requirements, data validation, and supervision of report development to support enterprise analytics, statistics, predictive modeling and external data submissions.
* Work directly and independently with the Analysts, Data Modelers and/or ETL Developers to create meaningful and actionable content for the enterprise.

* Partner with data scientists, operational teams, and researchers to develop and implement algorithms for performing predictive and prescriptive analytics.

* Utilizes expertise when researching and reviewing benchmarking data for comparison, validation, and utilization. Identifies areas for greatest opportunity for intervention.
* Creates concise, board\\-level written narrative summaries that outline project purpose, methodology, summary of findings, trends of interest, and opportunities for consideration.
* Develop and manage business relationships with key business leaders, project team members and senior leaders across the enterprise.
* Manage the identification and standardization of key measurement that drive enhanced patient flow.

 **Required Qualifications*** B.S./B.A. Business, Industrial Engineering, Information Technology, or related field

* Reporting and data analytic experience with clinical data including EHR clinical data expertise
* Experience participating in the peer review processes and can foster technical learning across the teams through mentoring and coaching
* Extensive experience in leading teams or complex projects
* Excellent communication skills (verbal and written)
* Experience with SQL, EHR, ERP systems and applications along with Microsoft products (SharePoint, Teams, Excel, etc.)
* Ability to build partnerships and collaborate with all levels of the organization

**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience with project flow management, business analysis, as well as specific skills directly aligned with patient flow

description:
**What You Will Do:**  

  

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail\\-oriented Data Modeler to join our data architecture and engineering team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining conceptual, logical, and physical data models that define how our organization's data is structured, stored, and accessed. You will act as a crucial bridge between business requirements and technical implementation, ensuring our data assets are consistent, accurate, and optimized for both operational efficiency and advanced analytics.



This hybrid on\\-site position is located at our headquarters in Oak Creek, WI. You will report directly to the Manager, Business Intelligence \\& Data Science.

  




**How You Will Do It:**

* **Data Model Design \\& Development:**
* + Create and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models for various data initiatives, including transactional systems, data warehouses, data lakes, and data marts.
	+ Translate complex business requirements and rules into clear, concise, and accurate data structures.
	+ Determine appropriate data modeling techniques (e.g., relational, dimensional, NoSQL) based on business needs and technical constraints.
* **Collaboration \\& Communication:**
* + Work closely with business stakeholders, data architects, data engineers, ETL developers, and data analysts to gather requirements, validate designs, and ensure alignment across data initiatives.
	+ Facilitate discussions and workshops to define data entities, attributes, relationships, and business rules.
* **Data Governance \\& Standards:**
* + Define and enforce data modeling standards, naming conventions, and best practices to ensure consistency and maintainability across the enterprise.
	+ Contribute to the development and management of data dictionaries, glossaries, and metadata repositories.
* **Optimization \\& Performance:**
* + Collaborate with database administrators and data engineers to optimize data models for performance, scalability, and cost\\-efficiency.
	+ Advise on indexing strategies, partitioning, and other physical design considerations.
* **Data Quality \\& Integrity:**
* + Ensure data models support data quality initiatives by incorporating appropriate constraints, validation rules, and integrity checks.
	+ Understand and document data lineage to track data flow from source to consumption.
* **Evaluation \\& Improvement:**
* + Review existing data models and databases for variances, discrepancies, and opportunities for optimization.
	+ Stay current with industry trends and emerging data modeling tools and methodologies.
  


  

**What We Look For:**


**Required**


* Minimum of a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or another related quantitative field from an accredited institution.
* Minimum three years of professional experience as a Data Modeler, Data Architect, or a similar role with a strong focus on data modeling.

* Experience in an Agile/Scrum development environment.

We are a team that designs computers, displays and electronic systems for aircraft of the future! At Astronautics, you will be part of a creative group of professionals who work on the cutting\\-edge of technology. We offer competitive pay, excellent benefits and the opportunity for professional growth in a collaborative environment.
